newsitem.title: USA: Four USDA undersecretaries at Wednesday hearing.
newsitem.headline: Four USDA undersecretaries at Wednesday hearing.

text.p: Four nominations for U.S. agriculture undersecretary, including Gus Schumacher to oversee domestic and foreign farm programs, will be considered Wednesday by the Senate Agriculture Committee, chairman Richard Lugar said Friday.
Schumacher now is Foreign Agriculture Service administrator.

Also to be considered at the hearing would be nominations of Miley Gonzalez for research undersecretary, Catherine Woteki for food safety undersecretary and Shirley Watkins for undersecretary for food and consumer services.
Hearing was set for 0900 EDT/1300 GMT in room 328A of the Russell Senate Office Building.
